ticket.title: Total Hours is displayed inconsistently in Month View

scope: Read-only check that Attendance > Month View toolbar stats (Scheduled/Total/Absence hours) are stable for the same month regardless of week anchor/navigation. Excludes verifying the reported value 55 (needs an account with logged hours in June 2026).

cases.title: Month View stats stable for June 2026 after navigating away and back

steps.action: Attendance > Month view, observe current month (Oct 2026)
steps.expected: Toolbar shows month-wide stats, not one week (Scheduled hours > 40)
steps.actual: October 2026 Month view: Scheduled hours: 168, Total hours: 0, Absence hours: 48 (month-wide, not the 40 of a week)

steps.action: Navigate back to June 2026 via Previous month, read stats
steps.actual: June 2026: Scheduled hours: 160, Total hours: 0, Absence hours: 160

steps.action: Next month then Previous month back to June 2026
steps.actual: After Next month then Previous month: June 2026 still Scheduled 160 / Total 0 / Absence 160 (identical)

cases.title: Total Hours shows 55 (non-zero) consistently for June 2026
cases.preconditions: Account with ~55 logged hours in June 2026

steps.expected: Total hours equals month total on every visit
steps.actual: xiontechs account has no logged hours in June 2026 (Total hours 0, Absence 160); the reported 55 cannot be reproduced without an account with timesheet data
